# ToolForge Resume Reviewer

> ToolForge is a free browser-based resume reviewer. It checks common document structure and formatting signals, compares recognized job-description skill terms, and offers draft wording suggestions. Its scores are heuristics; it does not connect to or test employer applicant tracking systems.

## Core Capabilities
- **Resume review**: Checks selected text, section labels, contact fields, formatting signals, and measurable achievement details.
- **Job-description comparison**: Compares recognized skill terms in a job description with text in the resume. Unsupported or unrecognized terms are not assessed.
- **Draft wording suggestions**: Helps users structure achievement bullets while leaving factual claims and metrics for the user to provide.
- **Browser-side document handling**: Resume text is processed in the browser and is not sent to ToolForge application servers. The site loads fonts from Google Fonts; the optional UPI support dialog requests a QR image from qrserver.com.
